name: Let's Wrassle - Coaching Planner Software (Beta)
description:
Run your whole high school or college wrestling season from one place: season plan, roster and weight tracking, lineup builder, schedule and results, practice calendar and team budget. Works on your phone, tablet or computer, and saves to your own Google Sheet. Early beta: instant digital access.

Enter your team name and four season dates (first practice, first competition, postseason start and state finals), and the planner builds your whole season around them.

EARLY BETA
You're getting in early. The planner is ready to use for your season, and beta testers help shape what comes next. Send feedback anytime and you'll get every update as it's released.

WHAT'S INSIDE
Season plan: 47 coaching tasks dated from your season, from booking weight certification to the end-of-season banquet. Overdue tasks turn red.
Roster & weights: each wrestler's minimum weight, lowest eligible class, weekly loss limit and the first date they can make their class, worked out from alpha weight and body fat.
Weigh-in log: record every weigh-in. Your roster and lineup always use each wrestler's latest weight.
Lineup builder: pick a starter and backup at every weight. Anyone over weight or below their minimum gets flagged.
Schedule & results: duals, tournaments, the postseason and every match. Records, pins, takedowns and team points total automatically.
Practice calendar: every practice day from first practice to state finals, with a suggested focus for that point in the season and a 30-drill library.
Budget & fundraising: team budget and fundraising across 10 categories.
Checklists: tournament bag, equipment inventory and ready-to-use parent messages.
Dashboard: countdown to your next milestone, team record, next event, weight alerts, leaders and today's practice.

BUILT FOR YOUR WHOLE STAFF
Each order works on up to 5 Google accounts. The head coach and assistants all work in the same team spreadsheet, so everyone sees the same roster, weights and results.

WEIGHT RULES FOR HIGH SCHOOL AND COLLEGE
Choose from all six NFHS high school sets (boys and girls, 12, 13 or 14 classes) or the NCAA classes for men (125–285) and women (103–207). Minimum body fat fills in for you: 7% for males and 19% for females under NFHS (the 2026-27 figure), and 5% for men and 17% for women under the NCAA Weight Management Program. The 1.5% weekly loss limit is included, and every number can be edited to match your state association or conference. Always confirm weight decisions with your official weight management program.

TWO WAYS TO USE IT
Phone, tablet or any browser: go to app.letswrassleapparel.com, sign in with Google and enter your order number and checkout email once. Add it to your home screen for a full-screen app on iPhone or Android.
Google Sheets: make your own copy from the link in your Start Here PDF and work right in Google Sheets, even mat-side on your phone.

Coming soon: a desktop app for Mac and Windows.

WHAT YOU GET
Access to the planner at app.letswrassleapparel.com (activate with your order number)
Start Here Beta Tester PDF with your planner and Google Sheets links

This is a digital product. Nothing will be shipped. A free Google account is required, and your team's data stays in your own Google Drive.
